install.title: What to install
install.about: The panel checks the machine environment and the readiness of the project. Every line says which commands do not work without it.
install.env_file_what: Confluence/Jira tokens for the sync scripts. The panel only sees «set» or «empty».
install.engine_what: in the project {engine}, in the kit {kit}
install.ratchet_what: the git hook keeps the error count from growing
install.structure_ok: the folder schema matches the engine
install.extras_about: Optional packages: the core works without them and better with them. Each goes into its own venv under ~/.aurora/ and never leaks into the engine.
install.ex_pypi_behind: Git already has {git}, but pip still installs {pypi}: the release has not reached PyPI yet.
install.ex_mcp_on: The knowledge-base graph MCP server is connected to Aurora's agent
install.ex_mcp_off: The knowledge-base graph MCP server is not connected — reinstall graphify
install.ex_mcp_hint: For Claude Code or Cursor add this to their MCP settings; run it from the project folder — the graph is read from there (after the “Export the base graph” step).
install.ex_settings_about: For each gateway and role: the model, whether thinking is on and the chat-template fields exactly as they go into the request (extra_body). Change them in Setup → Agent. No keys here.
install.ex_settings_client: Client: one process, requests in parallel · no retries (the ring decides) · answer cap via max_tokens · one system message · only strings kept in the answer metadata
install.ex_settings_off: Pydantic AI is not in use: {why} — calls go over plain HTTP
install.ex_settings_on: Every model call goes through Pydantic AI {v}
install.ex_no_backends: No chat gateways are set up.
install.ex_compat_none: compatibility with Aurora is checked on the first model call
install.ex_compat_bad: failed the compatibility check: {why} — calls go over plain HTTP
install.gm_about: They check sign-in, rights and the repository through the server API and know its URLs: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea. Updating and sending projects work without them. Installed from the kit into ~/.aurora/git-providers/.
install.gm_github_newer: GitHub already has {v} — update the kit first, then the module.
install.gm_generic_about: For a server without a module: any https, ssh address or network folder. Updating and sending work through git itself; there is no API check of sign-in and rights — install a provider module above for that.
install.gm_project_missing: not installed: the API sign-in and rights check is unavailable; updating and sending work
install.gm_generic_version: built into engine {v} · updated together with the kit
install.python_path: The panel's Python: {path}. Packages are checked and installed into it — with «Install» or the command below.
install.recheck_hint: Installed from a terminal or winget — check again, no restart needed.
install.err.not_seen: {name} is installed, but the panel's Python does not see it — restart the panel
install.err.unknown: {name} is not on the install list
install.hs_about: Assistants on this machine that can get the Aurora server: the knowledge base of all projects, story review, the projects' Jira and Confluence, memory and a lock for bots. The assistant's file is copied before the edit; the copy is returned by a button in the row. The edit is made by code, not by a model: these files hold keys of other servers.
install.hs_found: Assistants found: {n} of {all} in the catalogue
install.hs_none: No assistants from the catalogue were found on this machine.
install.hs_failed: It did not work — no reason given
install.hs_new_file: no file yet — it will be created
install.hs_restore_ask: Restore the «{name}» settings file from the latest copy? The current one is saved to a copy too.
install.hs_restored: The «{name}» file was restored from a copy
install.hs_note.claude-code: Added by Claude Code's own command (claude mcp add --scope user): it maintains ~/.claude.json itself. The tool call timeout is the MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT variable.
install.hs_note.continue: A file of its own in ~/.continue/mcpServers/ — the shared config.yaml is not touched.
install.hs_note.jcode: jcode waits 30 s for a tool by default — the entry sets 1800 s: a review takes minutes.
install.hs_note.pi: pi connects MCP through the pi-mcp-extension extension — without it the entry has no effect.
install.hs_note.chatbox: Not an agent but a chat client, yet it speaks MCP: the aurora server appears in “Settings → MCP”. Connect while Chatbox is closed — on exit it rewrites its settings file, and an entry made with the window open would be lost. A review takes minutes: if Chatbox cuts the call, raise the timeout in its settings.
